name: default-mode-network
description: STL to SVG converter with shader-based edge detection

scripts.build: pnpm run build:both && pnpm run copy-index
scripts.build:both: pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:gameoflife:merge
scripts.build:gameoflife:merge: rm -rf build-gameoflife && APP_NAME=gameoflife OUTPUT_DIR=build-gameoflife craco build 2>&1 | grep -v 'ENOENT' || true && if [ -f build-gameoflife/game-of-life.html ]; then cp build-gameoflife/game-of-life.html build/; fi && mkdir -p build/static && if [ -d build-gameoflife/static ]; then cp -r build-gameoflife/static/* build/static/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi && rm -rf build-gameoflife
